about: Every /api route of aico serve and the gate it sits behind. Every route needs the startup token (and a same-origin or absent Origin) — src/server/index.ts handle(). token+human: the token is not enough to say yes for a person (decision-gate.ts). token+grant / token+passphrase: the vault. scripts/security-scan.mjs fails on a route that is not listed here; scripts/security-dast.mjs attacks every listed route. Classify a new route deliberately: what can a holder of only the token do with it?

audit/*.note: audit/export and audit/usage: the redacted audit stream and cost summary; the model can hold the token, so a person must be behind the request (policy/routes, ADR 0035)

connections/create.note: creates a connection record (a host the engine may later send a token to): human(); the base URL must be https, or opted-in private http

connections/credential.note: stores a token in the vault bound to the connection host: human(); the token travels in only and no route returns it

connections/detect.note: read: which provider and repository a registered project origin points at (no network)

connections/discover.note: read: repositories (or a project's work item process) through an already-connected host with its own stored token; cannot widen a host or write

connections/iteration-create.note: creates an iteration on the platform for a local sprint (the one place AICO creates a remote iteration): human()

connections/list.note: read: connections without credential names, with the managed-policy view

connections/map.note: maps a registered project to a repository; switching landing to pr makes the engine push aico/task-* branches, so it needs human() and a confirmed card

connections/mapping.note: read: a registered project mapping and its board chip

connections/pack-connect.note: makes a connection for an ENABLED connector pack with the hosts a person approved; the token is added separately by a person: human()

connections/pack-disable.note: switches a connector pack off: human()

connections/pack-enable.note: a person approves exactly the pack content they were shown (hash-bound; a pack that changed is refused); never reachable from the agent tool: human()

connections/pack-test.note: replays a pack's fixtures on a loopback server the engine starts and records which operations pass; no external request, grants nothing

connections/packs.note: read: connector packs with status, hosts, operations and effect classes (no credential exists in a pack)

connections/remove.note: removes a connection and its mappings: human()

connections/sync.note: pulls work items and observes pull requests of a registered project through an already-connected host; cannot widen any host

connections/test.note: runs the capability probe: read calls against the connection own host

connections/unmap.note: removes a project mapping (turns pr mode off): human()

connections/update.note: renames or turns a connection on or off; base URL and hosts cannot change: human()

control.note: read-only: the organisation sign-in status; no token is ever returned (control/routes, ADR 0040)

control/*.note: control/login (POST) and control/logout (POST): signing in lets an address dictate policy and signing out removes the organisation's restrictions, so a person must be behind them; control/sync and the login poll need only the token and can only tighten (control/routes, ADR 0040)

delivery/approve-batch.note: lands several low-risk, green tasks on the trunk with one yes: human(); the set is refused whole if any member is not eligible

delivery/attention.note: read: compact task state of every registered board, for notifications

delivery/board.note: read: the board of a registered project

delivery/dispatch.note: start (or raising maxParallel) lets the board spend money: human(); pause needs only the token

delivery/events.note: delivery/board frames for a registered project

delivery/plan.note: starts a plan-mode chat turn that can only write backlog tasks (Delivery tool); spends one planning turn

delivery/releases.note: GET reads the release history and plan (token); POST makes the version-bump commit and a local tag on the trunk: human()

delivery/releases/*.note: deploy runs the configured command and rollback creates a reverting task: both human() (ADR 0038)

delivery/scrum.note: read: mode, sprints, suggestions, velocity, the running sprint's burndown and the daily summary of a registered project (ADR 0039)

delivery/scrum/*.note: mode switch, estimate, dismiss and refine need only the token (none readies work: the dispatcher only starts tasks a person made ready; refine spends one planning turn like delivery/plan and can only suggest); accepting an agent's suggestion needs human() (ADR 0039)

delivery/sprints.note: create a planned sprint: a date range and a goal; nothing is committed or started

delivery/sprints/*.note: commit, start and close need human() (they fix the team's promise and ready work for the agents); summary, review, retro are reads and notes saves text (ADR 0039)

delivery/tasks.note: create a task in the backlog; nothing runs until a person promotes it and starts the dispatcher

delivery/tasks/*.note: PATCH edits/cancels (token); approve (lands on the trunk, or pushes the branch and opens the pull request in PR mode), merge-pr (asks the remote to merge), request-changes (restarts a run) and comment (reaches an agent's prompt as the person's word) need human(); diff is a read (ADR 0038, 0039)

editor/file.note: the web viewer: registered projects only, real path inside the project, text up to 2 MB, credential-looking files refused (server/editor)

editor/open.note: starts the person's editor: needs human(); the program comes from the user's own settings or is VS Code on the PATH, never from the request; no shell (server/editor, ADR 0030)

inbox/decide.note: approving a parked call needs human()

learning/preferences/act.note: activating a rule (prompt text) needs human()

longjob/decide.note: approving a long job needs human()

manage.note: enabling via the registries needs human()

permission.note: allow:true needs the UI key / connected client nonce (decision-gate.ts); a no needs only the token

policy.note: read-only: which settings the managed policy locks, the rules in force, the file's problems; no secrets (the policy has no field for one) (policy/routes, ADR 0035)

settings.note: changes listed as weakening need human(); see dast for which

skills/install.note: enabling an imported skill needs human()

ui/attach.note: trades the UI key for a nonce; refused without the key or cross-site

vault/approve.note: approval needs a grant or the passphrase

vault/grant.note: mints a grant from the passphrase
